style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。

style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。

style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

The technology Support Equipment is the basis for the research of all support companies. It enables the equipment of the same name, which is needed for most other support companies.
Support EquipmentRadios, Jeeps, Pontoons & other equipment used to support troops.

These technologies unlock and enhance ⟦0⟧ and some of their variants. These support companies focus on providing additional entrenchment to their divisions, as well as various ⟦1⟧ bonuses on both the offense and defense.

Engineer Company IConstruction of fortifications and breaching obstacles make combat engineers vital in the field. Giving our engineers a versatile role enables us to deploy them in the diverse situations where they will be needed.
Enables Unlocks Flamethrower Tank special project Military Engineering Vehicles special project
Armored Engineer CompanyCombining engineering expertise with armored protection, armored engineer units are specialized on clearing obstacles and supporting front-line advances under heavy fire.
Military Engineering Vehicles Engineer Company I
Engineer Company IIWith modern equipment and high explosives, our engineers can go beyond their traditional tasks and surprise the enemy with their ingenuity, at land and sea.

Engineer Company IVMaintaining local mobility while constructing what would previously have been considered permanent fortifications and supply systems, combat engineers of the future will ensure that no matter where our troops are attacked, they will be prepared.

These technologies unlock and enhance reconnaissance support companies, like ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧. These support companies focus on providing the Recon stat to their divisions, which can allow them to be more likely to select advantageous ⟦2⟧ in battle. They also provide various ⟦3⟧ movement bonuses and are some of the few support companies whose movement speeds can decrease the speed of their divisions.
Recon Company ISending smaller groups to scout ahead before moving in the main force allows us to gather intelligence about where the enemy is and how many we are facing.

Helicopter Recon CompanyHelicopters are able get a good vantage point of the battlefield regardless of the actual terrain, and thus make excellent forward scouts to provide accurate feedback to artillery barrages.

Recon Company IIReconnaissance missions are often dangerous and casualties are high. Preparing our patrols to move and withdraw rapidly and equipping them to clear obstacles placed by the enemy will increase their chances of coming back alive.
Upgrades Recon Companies: Reconnaissance: +200% Helicopter Recon: Reconnaissance: +100%
Recon Company IIIImprovements in radio technology change the way reconnaissance missions can be executed, enabling rapid communication of the gathered intelligence.
Upgrades Recon Companies: Reconnaissance: +200% Helicopter Recon: Reconnaissance: +100% Helicopter Brigade: Reconnaissance: +200%
Recon Company IVDeep reconnaissance operations, mixing espionage, guerilla operations and commando training, will aid our tactical choices and allow us to adapt our decision-making rapidly.

These technologies unlock and enhance ⟦0⟧ companies and their variants. These support companies focus on increasing the suppression of their divisions, making them more effective at handling ⟦1⟧ as off-map garrisons. They also somewhat improve the recovery rate of infantry brigades, allowing them to regain organization faster.

Military Police IRegular troops may be able to manage occupation for a shorter period of time, but they are first and foremost soldiers. Integrating military police into our forces will ensure we have people on the ground to respond to resistance and investigate sabotage.

Motorized Military PoliceEquipped with military motorbikes, these units are tasked with maintaining order behind the lines, escorting convoys, and conducting patrols. Their speed and mobility allow them to quickly respond to disruptions and, if needed, perform reconnaissance in active combat zones.
Military Engineering Vehicles Military Police I

Military Police IIBy engaging in regular police duties in occupied territories, such as traffic control and maintaining public order, our military police can minimize the chaos and confusion in which partisan movements can thrive in.
Upgrades Military police: Suppression Bonus: +10% Motorized Military Police: Suppression Bonus: +10% : Recovery Rate: +5%
Military Police IIICooperating with local spy networks and informers established before occupation, our military police can proactively prepare for where resistance is likely to arise.

Military Police IVSafely policing occupied territory is as much about returning to normalcy as it is about ruthlessly eliminating opposition. Our military police must ensure that this process starts early, to ensure safety for soldiers and civilians alike.

These technologies unlock and enhance ⟦0⟧ companies and their variants. These support companies focus on increasing the reliability of all equipment in their divisions, preventing losses to attrition and increasing recovery rates after battles. They also provide additional equipment capture ratio to their divisions, allowing them to steal some enemy equipment that would otherwise be lost in battles.

Maintenance Company IMaintenance, repair and overhaul are important to keep military equipment reliable and safe to use. Having companies dedicated to this will ensure that it's given appropriate attention.

Armored Maintenance CompanyThe use of armored recovery vehicles enables our maintenance personnel to recover and repair all kinds of equipment, ensuring maximum operational readiness on the battlefield.
Military Engineering Vehicles Maintenance Company I
Maintenance Company IIRoutine operational maintenance procedures minimize the risks of equipment breaking down and alerts troops to replace it before it does.

Maintenance Company IIIMaking sure that our troops always have the basic materials in the field to perform common repairs will prevent the continued use of equipment known to be damaged.

Maintenance Company IVExperiences with designing for active redundancy in the Great War can be renewed to work with more modern equipment to make maintenance easier.

These technologies unlock and enhance ⟦0⟧ companies and their variants. These support companies focus on reducing both the amount of casualties a division takes, especially in manpower, and protecting their divisions' ⟦1⟧ and their country's War support from the affects of casualties.
These technologies are also classified as motorized technologies, and can therefore benefit from corresponding ⟦0⟧ and technology bonuses.
Field Hospital IA casualty doesn't need to mean a dead soldier. Having immediate medical attention available for our wounded brought back to the rear is the first step towards ensuring this.
Helicopter Med-Evac CompanyIncoming wounded! We have incoming wounded! Helicopters provide even faster casualty evacuation than regular ambulances.
Field Hospital IIBy establishing the use of portable hospitals, bringing the medical care to where it is needed, we can stop many unnecessary deaths and permanent injuries.
Upgrades Field hospital: Trickleback: +10% Experience loss from casualties: -10% Helicopter Med-Evac: Trickleback: +12% Experience loss from casualties: -8% : Recovery Rate: +5%

Field Hospital IIISurgery is among the most common emergency procedures needed in the field. Procedures and tools for this must be available closer to the front, and we must ensure that skilled surgeons are part of the military medical units.

Upgrades Field hospital: Trickleback: +10% Experience loss from casualties: -10% Helicopter Med-Evac: Trickleback: +12% Experience loss from casualties: -8% : Recovery Rate: +5% Helicopter Brigade: Trickleback: +15% Experience loss from casualties: -10% : Recovery Rate: +5%

Field Hospital IVAlthough many improvements have been made in field medicine, many advances are improvised and we lack an established doctrine. With more experience, we can explain the role of these units more clearly and make improvised innovations permanent fixtures.

These technologies unlock and enhance ⟦0⟧ companies and their variants. These support companies focus on reducing the ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ usage of divisions to which they are attached, reducing the impacts of poor supply and allowing more of them to safely operate in the same area without overloading the supply network.
Logistics Company IHaving specialized Logistics Officers among our ranks will ensure that support networks are leveraged to minimize waste.

Helicopter Transport CompanyHelicopters equipped with transport pods or towing goods beneath them on a line can move supplies and equipment quickly and without regard for terrain. Getting stuck in the mud is a thing of the past!
Logistics Company IIAdapting our risk analyses to the new circumstances of war will improve the safety of our logistical support.
